diagram_math_checks.justification: The item Statement uses A-B bimodules as arrows A to B. For X:A to B, Y:B to D, Z:D to E and W:E to F, all five P_i retain the factor order X,Y,Z,W and contract exactly the B,D,E slots. Iterating step 1.1 gives A-F bimodules at every vertex. No reversed-arrow convention from another bicategory is imported.

alpha_1=a_(X,Y,Z) tensor_E 1_W maps P0 to P1 by step 3.1 and tensor functoriality in step 4.1. alpha_2=a_(X,Y tensor_D Z,W) has middle algebras B,E and maps P1 to P2. alpha_3=1_X tensor_B a_(Y,Z,W) uses the D,E associator inside the right B-F factor and maps P2 to P3. These give three forward arrows from P0 through P1,P2 to P3.

beta_1=a_(X tensor_B Y,Z,W) uses middle algebras D,E and maps P0 to P4. beta_2=a_(X,Y,Z tensor_E W) uses middle algebras B,D and maps P4 to P3. Thus the bottom route has two forward arrows with the same source and target as the top route.

Write q_R(U,V):U tensor V to U tensor_R V for the balanced split epimorphism constructed in step 1.1 and defined in def-separable-algebra-and-bimodule-in-fusion-category. For each parenthesization P_i define Q at leaves to be identities and recursively Q(U tensor_R V)=q_R(U,V) composed with (Q(U) tensor Q(V)); q_i is this Q with coherent ambient associators inserted. The balance relation is q_R(r_U tensor 1)=q_R(1 tensor l_V). The B,D,E balancing projectors commute because adjacent actions on Y and Z commute, as in step 2.1, so every q_i is balanced in each of the three slots. Tensoring preserves these split epimorphisms, making each q_i split epic.

Step 3.1 defines each associator by preserving the universal three-balanced map; step 4.1 defines tensor translates by preserving the pairwise balanced maps. Recursion defining q_i therefore gives alpha_1 q0=q1, alpha_2 q1=q2, alpha_3 q2=q3, beta_1 q0=q4 and beta_2 q4=q3. Hence both composites precomposed with split-epic q0 equal q3, proving alpha_3 alpha_2 alpha_1=beta_2 beta_1. The native final PNG visibly contains five vertices and these five directed edges, including P4 to P3; no cycle shorthand is used.

The original Statement, Facts and all five proof steps are preserved byte-for-byte. Remarks merely expand the existing step 3.1 comparison and explicitly state that the proof remains independent of the figure.
